Perfect! I've successfully implemented the summary feature for frai-gate. Here's a summary of what was done:

## Implementation Complete ✓

### 1. Added `renderSummary` function in `src/gate/report.ts`
- Exports the function as requested
- Format: `<VERDICT> <answered>/<total>` (e.g., `PASS 7/7`, `BLOCK 5/7: evaluation, transparency`)
- Counts answered checks as those without block-severity findings
- Lists blocked checks in GATE_CHECKS order, comma-and-space separated
- Special case: returns `BLOCK 0/7: structure` when gate section is missing

### 2. Added `--summary` flag to the `frai-gate check` command
- Prints one-line summary instead of full report
- Exit codes unchanged (1 on BLOCK, 0 on PASS/WARN)
- `--json` flag takes priority if both are provided
- Updated CLI usage message

### 3. Updated HELP text and added comprehensive tests
- Documented `--summary` in the help output
- Created `src/gate/report.test.ts` with 7 test cases covering:
  - Missing gate section (0/7: structure)
  - All checks answered
  - Multiple block findings in GATE_CHECKS order
  - Warning findings (don't reduce answered count)
  - Multiple findings from the same check (counted once)
  - Mix of block and warn findings

### 4. Verified the implementation
- Build succeeds with no TypeScript errors
- All 18 tests pass (7 new + 11 existing)
- CLI works correctly with `--summary` flag
- Priority handling: `--json` takes precedence over `--summary`

The feature is ready to use! Examples of the output format:
- `PASS 7/7` (all checks answered)
- `BLOCK 5/7: evaluation, transparency` (2 checks have block findings)
- `BLOCK 0/7: structure` (gate section missing)
